svg.aria-label: Half-reaction balancing and reaction-dependent n-factor symbolic bridge
svg.title: Half-reaction balancing and reaction-dependent n-factor symbolic bridge
svg.desc: For Half-reaction balancing and reaction-dependent n-factor, the displayed symbols mean: A balanced ionic redox equation conserves every element and total charge; reaction-specific electron transfer then determines n-factor. The diagram is a symbolic teaching representation and does not add unstated charge, phase, coefficient, or mechanism claims.

svg.text: Scope: read only the declared model/bookkeeping relation; no unstated mechanism is implied.
